section8_items.question: What if I am not happy with the staff?

section8_items.question: Do you provide 24-hour live-in care?

section8_items.question: Can you arrange ICU equipment at home?
section8_items.answer: Yes. We arrange oxygen, monitors, BiPAP, ventilator, hospital bed and other equipment along with an ICU-trained nurse.

section8_items.question: How much does home care cost?
section8_items.answer: The cost depends on the service, shift and patient condition. Call us or fill the form — our care manager will share the exact price on call.

pages.title: Privacy Policy

content.body:
This Privacy Policy explains how Home Care ("we", "us") collects, uses and protects the information you share with us through this website, phone calls and WhatsApp.

Information We Collect

  • Your name, mobile number, email address and area / locality.
  • Details about the care you need, such as the service, patient condition and preferred start date.
  • Basic technical data such as browser type, pages visited and IP address, collected by our website and analytics tools.

How We Use Your Information

  • To call you back and understand your care requirements.
  • To arrange suitable nurses, caretakers or therapists for the patient.
  • To send you service updates and respond to your questions.
  • To improve our website and services, including measuring our online advertising.

Sharing of Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We share only the necessary details with the staff member assigned to your family, and with service providers who help us run this website (such as hosting and email), under confidentiality.

Cookies & Advertising

Our website may use cookies and tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads and Meta Pixel to understand visits and show relevant ads. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

Data Security

We take reasonable steps to keep your information safe. Enquiries are stored securely and are accessible only to our team.

Your Choices

You may ask us to update or delete your information at any time by calling or emailing us.

Contact Us

For any privacy questions, contact us at {email} or call {phone}. Address: {address}.

pages.seo_description: Privacy policy of Home Care — how we collect, use and protect your personal information.

pages.title: Terms & Conditions

content.body:
By using this website or booking any service from Home Care, you agree to the following terms.

Our Services

We arrange trained nurses, caretakers, attendants and physiotherapists for care at your home. The exact duties of the staff are agreed with you before the service starts.

Booking & Charges

  • Charges depend on the service, shift and patient condition and are confirmed before the service starts.
  • Payment terms (advance / weekly / monthly) are shared at the time of booking.
  • Extra hours or additional duties may be charged separately.

Staff Replacement

If you are not satisfied with the staff member, please inform us and we will arrange a replacement as soon as possible.

Medical Responsibility

Our staff follow the treatment plan given by the patient's doctor. Home Care does not replace a doctor or hospital. In any emergency, please contact a doctor or hospital immediately.

Family Responsibilities

  • Share correct information about the patient's health and medicines.
  • Provide a safe working environment and basic facilities for live-in staff.
  • Do not hire our staff directly without informing us.

Cancellation

Please inform us at least 24 hours in advance to stop or change a service.

Contact

Questions about these terms? Call {phone} or email {email}.
